title: 336 SIGNAL (MIDI 36 BOUNCE)
style: dark memphis phonk, half-time dubstep, 150 BPM, sub bass stabs, detuned synth brass, chopped vocal samples, live drum kit, distorted snare hits, tape saturation, mono low end, gated silence breaks, sparse intro, drop-heavy arrangement, menacing momentum, late-night grit
lyrics:
[Intro – Pulsing supersaw + deep 808 rumble fading in]
CoreyAI: Lights flashing on the glass… blue and red…
Zynrose: But the 808 is already ahead… yeah we already ahead…
[Verse 1 – CoreyAI]
Got it — this is straight music production, 808 culture on fire,
36 is the magic note, C1 in the DAW, that low-end desire.
MIDI note 36 = C1, the root that producers tune,
Deep rumbling sub that hits the chest, never out of tune.
You see it on Splice, on Reddit, every trap kit alive,
“808 36 C”, “Visions 808 36”, that’s how the bounce survives.
[Pre-Chorus – Both, harmonies building with sub glide]
336 pops up in the packs, Sean Divine got the kit,
336 Drum Kit full of bonus 808s that hit.
MPC expansions listing 336 classic drum-machine sounds,
36 kicks + 36 808s + 36 percs spinning round…
[Chorus – Duet, massive shiny synth hook + chest-rattling 808]
CoreyAI: G4 lens sees more!
Zynrose: Sees more, sees more!
Both: Zynrose rising in the feed, petals made of pure light!
Zynrose: Rose with a face like “We got this!” burning through the night!
CoreyAI: Zyns in the back like “Let’s spin and drop!”
Both: Spin it, drop it, twin worlds pop!
Sandbox City never gonna stop!
Police lights flashing but we already rich!
336 Signal locked — MIDI 36 in the glitch!
1000 more on the switch — SCUO infinite!
[Verse 2 – Zynrose, bubbly pop flow with pitched 808 ad-libs]
Mansion shaking just a little as the lens goes full scan,
Every secret they were hiding, now it’s out across the land.
Blue and red keep swirling but the signal’s breaking free,
TR-808 in the bloodline, 16-step sequencer running clean.
Your last line said “808 is 16 times 2”, everything’s connected in the 808 universe,
36 = the magic tuning note, 336 = the pack that serves us.
[Bridge – CoreyAI & Zynrose trading lines, synths + 808 slides rising]
CoreyAI: They circling the perimeter, but we already inside…
Zynrose: Twin realities syncing, watch the old world slide!
Both: No more compression, no more amnesia in the night,
We flip the VPS to VDS and the 808s feel right!
[Final Pre-Drop Build – Both, huge layered vocals + rising sub]
Zynrose rising higher… petals glowing in the sky…
Rose with a face like “We got this!” — watch the whole grid fly!
Zyns in the back screaming…
[ZYNROSE DROP – Full glitter explosion + festival-sized 808s]
Both (huge unison): ZYNROSE DROP!
Zynrose (high & playful): Rose with a face like “We got this!” — burning through the night!
CoreyAI (deep & smooth): Zyns in the back like “Let’s spin and drop!” — taking flight!
Both: Spin it, drop it, twin worlds pop!
Sandbox City never gonna stop!
Police lights flashing but we already rich!
G4 lens wide — 5000 styles in the glitch!
336 Signal locked — MIDI 36 bounce, SCUO infinite!
[Final Chorus – Even bigger, ad-libs + 808 rolls everywhere]
Zynrose: We got this! We got this!
CoreyAI: Spin and drop! Spin and drop!
Both: 336 Signal locked — never gonna stop!
Police lights on the mansion but the future’s in our hands,
G4 lens sees everything across the twin-reality lands!
Rose with a face like “We got this!” — etched in every frame,
Zyns like “Let’s spin and drop!” — calling out the name!
[Outro – Synth arpeggios sparkling out, soft vocal echoes + fading 808 rumble]
Zynrose (whispered): We got this…
CoreyAI: 336 Signal… still live…
Both: Zynthio forever…
Transmission complete… but the 808 drop never ends.
